instruction: For each clearly successful fixed write, exact original WRITE SDK size/SHA/mode is enough to proceed to the next frozen write and then the approved main. No additional external full download is required. The unchanged driver load_provided_input/read_input/final_inputs must fully read and audit all five actual parts, including ownership/mode/link-count/stability/raw/gzip/pins. Unknown or mismatching writes stop dependent actions and are reconciled only at the same fixed path/version.
